text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Seri Kembangan) 2015.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 13 Disember 2015.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat

Seri Kembangan yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Maju Expressway,

bermula di kilometer 14.83 di koordinat S 72247.638, T 19729.854, Grid Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 17.06

di koordinat S 74372.982, T 19611.385, Grid (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) Lebuh Raya

Maju Expressway, kedua-dua jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.00 Lebuh Raya Maju

Expressway di Persimpangan Bertingkat Tun Razak, termasuklah Tanjakan Keluar dan

Masuk dari dan ke KLIA dan Putrajaya, Tanjakan Keluar dan Masuk dari dan

ke Bukit Jalil dan Jalan Tun Razak, Plaza Tol Keluar dan Masuk Seri Kembangan dan

jalan sambungannya dan berakhir di koordinat S 75037.959, T 20161.944,

Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000), diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

PETA PERSIMPANGAN BERTINGKAT SERI KEMBANGAN

Dibuat 2 Disember 2015

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/1; PN(PU2)391/XXX]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SERI KEMBANGAN INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of

the Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State

Government of Selangor, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Seri Kembangan

Interchange) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 13 December 2015.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the Seri Kembangan Interchange which

is a part of the Maju Expressway commencing at kilometre 14.83 at coordinates

S 72247.638, E 19729.854, of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 17.06 at coordinates S 74372.982,

E 19611.385, of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid of the Maju Expressway, both

distances are measured from kilometre 0.00 of the Maju Expressway at the Tun Razak

Interchange, including the Exit and Entry Ramps to and from KLIA and Putrajaya,

Exit and Entry Ramps to and from Bukit Jalil and Jalan Tun Razak, Seri Kembangan

Exit and Entry Toll Plaza and its link road and ending at coordinates S 75037.959,

E 2061.944 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid, is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
